commit.message:
Record the archival DOI and repository URL in CITATION.cff

The v1.0.0 release is archived at 10.5281/zenodo.22137806. The manifest is
recomputed accordingly. No new release is cut: the article cites the frozen
v1.0.0 deposit, and a new release would mint a new DOI.
